principle: AI agents may research, draft, and policy-check. Sending or channel activation is blocked unless the current legal-channel-release-gates policy explicitly clears the exact channel and its evidence is recorded.
autonomous_actions_allowed: research local businesses from approved public/source inputs
enrich lead records from public business info
create lead records with source paths and confidence labels
classify business type and likely phone pain
choose approved message angle by segment
draft outbound messages from approved templates
prepare manual-send packets with required evidence
generate call lists from approved source notes
generate email campaigns from approved segments

conditions: legal-channel-release-gates explicitly clears the exact channel
target lead is real and source-backed
message passes brand voice and truth policy
platform does not require human confirmation

lead_quality_requirements: business appears relevant to missed-call, after-hours, front-desk, booking, urgent, or callback pain
